transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been having some trouble with eating. After my evening class, I’ll stop for food and sometimes it turns into a full fast-food meal, then candy from a vending machine, and more snacks when I get home. It feels like I’m making up for the whole day or something.
Do you feel guilty after these episodes of eating?
Yeah… I do. I try to stop, like tell myself to close the bag and just go to bed, but I keep reaching for more. Afterward I feel pretty embarrassed… kind of sick of myself.
How often do these episodes of eating happen?
Usually… maybe once a week. It’s been going on about three months, I guess. Mostly one night after class where I eat too much and then… make myself throw up.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?
Usually once a week… for the last three months or so. It’s mostly after class, when I overeat, and then I make myself throw up afterward.
Do you worry about gaining weight?
Yeah… I do. Even if the scale’s just up a pound the next morning, I get this knot in my stomach. I start thinking people in class will look at me like I’m some sloppy old guy who let himself go.
Do you do anything else to try to counteract the calories you consume during these episodes, like exercising excessively?
Not really… I mean, I don’t think so. I don’t go work out for hours or anything like that.
Do you use laxatives or diuretics to try to counteract the calories you consume during these episodes?
No… not laxatives or water pills. It’s more that a few times after eating late, I’ve gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up… because I was scared it would show on me.
Do you think about food or calories a lot during the day, even when you're not eating?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes, but I haven’t really kept track of it. It’s not something I think about every minute or anything.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your weight over the past three months?
Not that I’ve really noticed. I mean, my clothes feel about the same, I think. I don’t weigh myself that much.
Do you feel like you're losing control when you're eating during these episodes?
Yeah… I guess so. Once I start on the snacks, I’ll tell myself to just close the bag and go to bed, but I keep reaching in anyway. Then afterward I just feel… embarrassed, kind of sick of myself.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating once you start during these episodes?
Yeah… during those times, it feels like I can’t really stop. I’ll tell myself to put it away and just go to bed, but I keep reaching for more anyway. Then I feel pretty ashamed afterward.
Is your fear of gaining weight the main reason you make yourself throw up after eating?
Yeah… I guess that’s part of it. A few times after I ate like that late at night, I went and made myself throw up because I was scared it would… you know, show on me.
Do you think your eating habits are related to stress, anxiety, or emotional issues?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I haven’t really paid that close attention to it. It just kind of happens, I guess.
Do you often think about your body shape or weight during the day?

Sometimes, yeah. Not all day, exactly, but… if my shirt feels tight around my middle, I keep thinking about it. Makes me feel like I’ve sort of failed at keeping myself disciplined, even if everything else that day is fine.
Do you typically eat a normal amount of food during the day before one of these episodes of overeating at night?
I’m not really sure. Some days I think I eat pretty normal, other days I might skip around a bit… I haven’t kept track closely.
Have these episodes of overeating and then making yourself throw up been happening for more than three months?
Yeah… I think so. It’s been, maybe, around five months now. It kind of started after I began those evening Certified Bookkeeper classes.
Do you make yourself throw up every time you have one of these episodes of overeating?
Not every time. Just… a few times after those late-night eating spells, I’ve gone to the bathroom and made myself throw up. I get scared it’s all going to show on me.
Do you make yourself throw up after every episode of overeating, or is it just sometimes?
Just sometimes. Not after every time… a few times I’ve gone and made myself throw up after those late-night eating spells, because I got scared it was all going to show on me.
Do you make yourself throw up after most of your overeating episodes or just a few of them?
Just a few of them… not most. A few times after those late-night eating spells, I went to the bathroom and made myself throw up. I was scared it would show on me.
Do you make yourself throw up after more than half of your overeating episodes?
No… not more than half. Just a few times, after those late-night eating spells. I’d get scared it was going to show on me, so I made myself throw up.
